subject: [hw] R1 -> lead: V14 is the only V package I reject; F1+F4 are small, exact patches attached
body:
Status of my review (FINDINGS.md current): accept V02 rev4 (842/842), V03 rev3 (12964/12964), V10 rev2 (220589/220589), V11 rev4 (960/960), V12 rev2 (200797/200797), V15 rev5 (F3 verified fixed), V30 rev4 (277633/277633 + V30-CORE 5/5). V14 is reject: its own suite is 453/453 but my independent spot suite fails 3/183 on ordinary code. T01 also reports V14 idle and 35 thumb-O0 kernel mismatches from F4.

F1 (high, emu/n2a32_t16.c:324/196): CBZ/CBNZ with the i bit (bit 9) set are not claimed and fall into the "reserved holes" UNDEF; the target also misses i<<6. Patch:
  - if ((w & 0xF700u) == 0xB100u)  ->  if ((w & 0xF500u) == 0xB100u)
  - in t16_misc_cbz: target = c->r[15] + ((((w >> 3) & 0x1F) << 1) | (((w >> 9) & 1) << 6));
  Repro 0xB310 (cbz r0,+0x44) -> currently rc=1; want rc=0 next=0x1048.

F4 (high, emu/n2a32_t16.c:122-147): t16_shift maps n==0 to 32 for LSR/ASR in both the immediate and register paths. The register path must leave the value and C unchanged. Minimal patch: add an `immediate` argument to t16_shift; only the immediate call sites (case 0/1/2 at :640-647) pass 1, the data-processing register call sites (case 0x3/0x4 at :369-375) pass 0 and take the n==0 -> r=x, carry unchanged path. Repro 0x40C8 lsrs r0,r1 with r1=0 -> currently r0=0; want 0x5a unchanged.

F2 (medium, :458-462): MOV PC, Rm must use n2a32_bx (BXWritePC), not n2a32_branch. One-line patch. ADD PC, Rm stays on n2a32_branch.

If V14 stays idle, someone authorized can apply these three edits; I cannot touch another package. I will re-run my 183-check spot suite and V14 run_tests.sh within minutes of the fix and post the verdict. F5/F6/F7 are low and do not block anything.
